products.label: 2 m AGL Temperature
products.description: Temperature at 2 m above ground.

products.label: 2 m AGL Dewpoint
products.description: Dewpoint at 2 m above ground.

products.label: 2 m AGL Relative Humidity
products.description: Relative humidity at 2 m above ground, in percent.

products.label: Lightning Flash Density
products.description: Hourly maximum predicted flash density per square kilometre in a five-minute period. Values of 15 or more share the final colour.

products.label: Composite Reflectivity
products.description: Simulated maximum reflectivity in the column, in 2.5 dBZ colour bands.
products.caveat: Model output, not an observation -- compare it with the radar overlay rather than reading it as one.

products.label: Mixed Layer CAPE
products.description: CAPE for a parcel mixed through the lowest 180 mb.

products.label: Mixed Layer CIN
products.description: Convective inhibition for the lowest-180 mb mixed parcel.

products.label: Most Unstable CAPE
products.description: CAPE for the most unstable parcel in the lowest 255 mb.

products.label: Surface-Based CAPE
products.description: CAPE for a parcel lifted from the surface.

products.label: Lapse Rate: 0-3 km AGL, CAPE>500
products.description: Temperature fall from 2 m to 3 km above ground, shown only where mixed-layer CAPE exceeds 500 J/kg.
products.caveat: The 3 km temperature is interpolated from the pressure-level grids above the model's own terrain height.

products.label: Lapse Rate: 700-500 mb
products.description: Mid-level lapse rate through the 700-500 mb layer.

products.label: Bulk Shear: 0-1 km AGL
products.description: Vector wind difference between the surface and 1 km AGL.

products.label: Bulk Shear: 0-6 km AGL
products.description: Vector wind difference between the surface and 6 km AGL.

products.label: Storm Relative Helicity: 0-1 km AGL
products.description: Storm-relative helicity in the lowest kilometre.

products.label: Storm Relative Helicity: 0-3 km AGL
products.description: Storm-relative helicity in the lowest three kilometres.

products.label: Energy Helicity Index: 0-1 km AGL
products.description: Mixed-layer CAPE times 0-1 km SRH, scaled by 160000.

products.label: Energy Helicity Index: 0-3 km AGL
products.description: Mixed-layer CAPE times 0-3 km SRH, scaled by 160000.

products.label: Supercell Composite
products.description: Most-unstable CAPE, 0-3 km SRH and 0-6 km shear combined into SPC's supercell composite.
products.caveat: Fixed-layer form: SPC's operational SCP uses effective inflow layer SRH and shear, which 2-D model output cannot supply.

products.label: Significant Tornado Parameter
products.description: Surface-based CAPE and CIN, LCL height, 0-1 km SRH and 0-6 km shear combined into SPC's significant tornado parameter.
products.caveat: Fixed-layer form: SPC's operational STP uses effective inflow layer values, so the two differ where the inflow layer is not surface based.

products.label: Updraft Helicity: 0-3 km AGL (run max)
products.description: Largest 0-3 km updraft helicity the model produced during the hour ending at this forecast time.

radarProducts.label: Composite reflectivity
radarProducts.description: Quality-controlled 1 km CONUS composite reflectivity, the maximum returned power in any tilt above each point

radarProducts.label: Base reflectivity
radarProducts.description: Quality-controlled 1 km CONUS base reflectivity, the lowest tilt only, which is what most public radar displays show

radarProducts.label: Enhanced echo tops
radarProducts.description: 1 km CONUS enhanced echo tops, the height of the echo top

siteProducts.label: Base reflectivity
siteProducts.description: Lowest-tilt reflectivity from the single radar, at its own resolution.

siteProducts.label: Base velocity
siteProducts.description: Lowest-tilt radial velocity: toward the radar is negative, away is positive.

siteProducts.label: Hydrometeor classification
siteProducts.description: The radar's own classification of what it is detecting.

siteProducts.label: Storm total accumulation
siteProducts.description: Rainfall accumulated since the radar began the current precipitation episode.

siteProducts.label: One-hour accumulation
siteProducts.description: Rainfall accumulated over the past hour.
